sentiment.instructions: Classify the overall sentiment of the text. Base your judgment only on the attitude the text itself expresses, not on whether you agree with it or on whether the events it describes are good or bad.

positive.description: The author expresses a favorable attitude, even if only mildly.
examples: Not even 20 pages into Paper Towns and the book centers around the night of May 5th. I know its gonna be a good one now!

neutral.description: The author expresses no attitude, as when merely reporting news or facts, even if those facts are pleasant or unpleasant.
examples: I may be sleep deprived but I promise you that some kid at Dunkin today looked like a sprout.

negative.description: The author expresses an unfavorable attitude, even if only mildly.
examples: The tragedy of only thinking up hilarious tweets for the Summer Olympics now is that in four years there may be no place for them.
